purpose: A contradiction plus more problems than max_findings allows: highest severity first.

acceptance_criteria.text: A shopper can save up to 5 delivery addresses.
Guests can save a delivery address for their next visit.
Only registered shoppers have an address book.
The default address is pre-selected at checkout.

findings.quote: Guests can save a delivery address
findings.explanation: AC2 lets guests save an address but AC3 gives an address book only to registered shoppers.
findings.question: Can guests save a delivery address, given that only registered shoppers have an address book?

findings.explanation: It is not stated what happens when a shopper tries to save a 6th address.
findings.question: What happens when a shopper tries to save a 6th delivery address?

must: the AC2/AC3 contradiction is one of them
must_not: drop the contradiction in favour of a low-severity finding
may: quote AC3 instead of AC2 for the contradiction
